industry: Industrial and Commercial Machinery and Computer Equipment

machinery_computer_equipment_category.label: Machinery / computer-equipment category
machinery_computer_equipment_category.value: Building and HVAC/R products (grilles, coils, air handlers, fire/smoke protection, railings) plus industrial lubricants and sealants; not heavy machinery

aftermarket_sales_mix.label: Aftermarket sales mix
aftermarket_sales_mix.value: Mostly product sales through distribution; lubricants for equipment maintenance are consumable, with some installation and service in smoke protection

engineering_customization.label: Engineering / customization
engineering_customization.value: Mix of catalogue products and pre-engineered or custom architectural components, engineered railings and fire-rated systems

service_maintenance_requirement.label: Service / maintenance requirement
service_maintenance_requirement.value: Products support customers' equipment maintenance and reliability; installation and service offered by Smoke Guard in some regions

notes: CSW is a diversified industrial products maker, not a machinery OEM; equipment-base facets mostly do not apply.
